proposedBellaRules.scope: OMF Duration contribution in an already-read supported header. Kind accepted; no runtime implementation/cutover, Bin Filter change, final priority table, new Duration-only header open or routine database/header comparison.
proposedBellaRules.ownerAndCount: Qualified full-ID physical file owner, safely resolved own supported descriptor, exact typed Length and SampleRate. Nonnegative count and positive rate; no clip/master/source GroupLength or other-source count/clock substitution. Preserve independently valid data and inventory on field failure.
proposedBellaRules.wireAndValues: Known legacy Long signed32 Length and ExactEditRate two signed32 words/eight bytes in established numeric order. Preserve Avid field names and valid original source words. Internal64 count is not extended64 wire approval. Unsupported/damaged/negative/sentinel/ambiguous required timing is unavailable, not zero.
proposedBellaRules.interpretation: Share approved pure source-qualified AvidDurationInterpreter: exact23.976*k ->24000*k/1001 and29.97*k->30000*k/1001, k1..10, including exact equivalent fractions. Apply to known video ExactEditRate and qualified audio display EditRate; not audio frequency or arbitrary Rational; no approximate snapping. Semantic conversion precedes exact common arithmetic.
proposedBellaRules.boundedAudioRateRecovery: Usable ownMDFL pair first. When MDFL rate is unusable, permit valid unambiguous already-decoded same-owned supported WAVD:Summary.fmt /AIFD:Summary.COMM frequency, including accepted contextual WAVE descriptor compatibility. Retain raw rate availability and compact selected recovery origin/status. Never substitute summary frame count or outer native chunk count for OMF Length or conceal contradictory required timing. Audio summary/native decoder details continue in subsequent field review.
proposedBellaRules.audioDisplayClock: Same qualified file mob own typed CPNT:EditRate only; interpreted exact display clock is separate from audio frequency and does not fill audio Frame Rate column. Missing/damaged/ambiguous positive-audio display clock leaves label blank while exact sample duration survives. No master/project/other-source clock guess.
proposedBellaRules.mathsAndDisplay: Share DurationFormatter and verified checked integer/fraction maths. Video physical frames at interpreted clock; audio exact sample duration converts to display frames with a single final nearest/positive-half-up rounding. Nominal base only for numbering. Retain samples, show genuine0 and valid rounded0, permit hours>24, no StartTC/inclusive-end addition. Existing established-zero exception and mode separators apply.
proposedBellaRules.numbering: Qualified applicable file/source full ID, essence track/kind, mapped position/span, compatible exact clock and nominal FPS. Legacy Flags full numeric32 word bit0. Agreed simple direct/immediate-source scope; DF initially30000/1001/base30 or60000/1001/base60. Complete proven absence=>NDF; damaged/broken/ambiguous/mixed/unsupported applicable mode=>blank label. NDF-only clock needs no unrelated flag walk. DFHH;MM;SS;FF, NDFHH:MM:SS:FF.
proposedBellaRules.retention: Compact exact count/rate/source context, necessary own audio display clock and numbering/availability state. Keep no permanent raw object graph, summary copy or formatted label solely for Duration. Scoped temporary lifetimes, QtEndian and C++17 fixed-width values with checked/wide or factor-cancelled integer operations.
proposedBellaRules.nativeDifference: Do not automatically copy native AIFD/WAVD summary frequency overrides or zero-Length summary count fill. Bella deliberately preserves selected OMF Length and genuine-zero principle. Native metadata reader behavior does not establish universal GUI Duration behavior.
proposedBellaRules.sourceBoundary: Preserve agreed MDB-first principle. This OMF field review defines no new header-open trigger or final cross-source eligibility/priority and introduces no hybrid timing.

mdvx.recommendationBoundary: MDVx has no ordinary inventory Duration behavior for Bella to copy. Bella must derive supported physical count/rate/legacy interpretation, display clock and qualified drop-frame rules from native/current/actual-format evidence and the separately agreed requirements.
limits: Installed arm64 only, x86_64 not independently reconstructed.
No whole-app claim that a raw browser or embedded library cannot read a Length/timecode.
No OMF actual-file duration or measured speed/memory result supplied by this receipt.
No additional OMF versions, extra file-opening reasons, Bin Filter or source-priority decisions.

current.status: Current source/test research only. No runtime code, tests/builds, apps/private APIs, production parsers or media reads/writes. OMF Duration recommendations await approval.

duplicate-required-values.note: Unique decoded property accepts equal repeats, rejects unreadable or differing required values.

scalar-rate-admission.note: Count conversion to qint64; rate requires positive int32 numerator/denominator in decoded map.

own-descriptor-duration-call.note: Qualified physical owner passes its own descriptor and own editRate to technical(), then file-source timecode lookup. No master length passed.

own-edit-clock.note: Own CPNT:EditRate preferred; if absent, agreeing own MSLT EditRate slots. Present unusable CPNT does not trigger slot fallback. OMF2 slots are outside Bella release-one schema.

current-drop-graph.note: Walk own components and recursively referenced source mobs, collect every TCCP Flags/Drop integer0/1. No per-flag damaged observation or FPS/track-specific qualification.

typed-object-order.note: Object metadata numeric order follows established HEAD/local rule, distinct from Bento TOC order. Contrary local override unsupported in current reader.

numeric-wire-forms.note: Supported generic numeric decoding: signed32 and signed64 named types; Rational/ExactEditRate two signed32 words in eight bytes. No decimal-to-NTSC duration interpretation here.

descriptor-clock-and-summary.note: MDFL SampleRate first; own class-qualified WAVD/WAVE or AIFD Summary supplies frequency only if descriptor rate unusable and summaries agree.

physical-length-pair.note: MDFL Length nonnegative plus usable unitsRate emits Duration. Audio display clock own editRate; video display clock unitsRate. Raw fractions retained, no clip/master length replacement.

audio-samples-retained.note: Audio observations preserve count/rate; descriptor Summary calls duration=false, so copied summary frame counts do not replace MDFL Length.

aiff-extended-rate.note: AIFF sampling frequency decoded from ten-byte extended field into exact representable int32 fraction; sample frame count separately recorded.

native-audio-duration.note: Separate native route derives uncompressed WAVE frame count from one data extent/blockAlign or AIFF COMM count. Recording samples are not read for this calculation.

duration-map-storage.note: Shared typed-to-QVariant bridge stores exact units/rate/displayRate/source.

duration-source-policy.note: Current duration source preference header before MDB; not final Bella source policy.

drop-source-policy.note: Current DropFrame is independently source-ranked; no coherent Duration/flag aggregate in this policy.

shared-clock-supplement.note: Shared selector supplements display clock only from eligible duration observations with same count and equivalent rate. Does not change selected count/rate.

row-duration-and-drop.note: Selected duration copied; missing/unresolved DropFrame toBool becomesfalse. timecodeBase is rounded selected displayRate, with formatter fallback available.

exact-storage-zero-gap.note: Exact qint64 count, int32 fractions; known requires units>0. Zero therefore currently unavailable to formatter.

wide-frame-conversion.note: Shared integer limb product/division and half-up rounding at final frame boundary. Overflow/unavailable and valid rounded-zero all return0.

base-and-frame-format.note: Nominal base from timecodeBase or parsed FrameRate label; zero displayFrames yields blank. DF mathematics enabled by flag and base30/60 only, not exact-clock qualification. Hours not wrapped at24.

duration-label.note: DF all-semicolon HH;MM;SS;FF; NDF colon. Unknown blank.

test-reader-default.note: Projection tests default MDB unless false/direct OmfReader.

test-native-audio-direct.note: Direct OmfReader native PCM/float WAVE asserts samples48000 clock and count2, not embedded OMF timing.

test-drop-and-length-mdb.note: Default MDB authored test: descriptor length beats master clip, linked flag ignores orphan, conflicting flags do not erase exact length. Not direct OMF proof.

test-copied-summary-default-mdb.note: Copied audio fixture omits MDFL rate and supplies Summary plus MDFL Length96000. Uses default MDB reader, not direct OMF.

test-conflicting-summary-mdb.note: Default MDB Summary-rate conflict means no Duration; not direct OMF real-media proof.

test-raw-decimal-retained-mdb.note: Default MDB assertion explicitly preserves raw decimal rate in current Duration; only compression naming has a separate alias.

test-genuine-direct-duration-limit.note: Mixed genuine files; explicit OMF rows assert nonempty FileDuration evidence, not exact count/label/DF.

test-shared-exact-clock-rules.note: Shared selection tests use authored observations, equivalent unreduced fractions and display-clock disagreement; not media parser tests.

test-timecode-format-and-long.note: Common display tests cover DF transitions, semicolons, long hours, old zero-as-blank and label-base fallback; inspected only.

findings.finding: Current OMF Duration uses the positive physical owner’s own MDFL:Length with MDFL:SampleRate. Length is a qint64 count internally, units are descriptor frames/edit units or audio sample frames according to descriptor meaning. It does not use CLIP:Length, GroupLength or master duration as a substitute. Count is not multiplied by channel count.

anchors: typed-object-order
numeric-wire-forms
scalar-rate-admission
findings.finding: Generic reader accepts signed four-byte Long/Int32/Length32 (also other generic integer types) and eight-byte Int64/Length64. Rational/ExactEditRate are two signed32 words in eight bytes, decoded in established metadata numeric order. Projection requires nonnegative count and positive int32 rate components, but does not itself whitelist a field-specific integer type. Internal64-bit storage and synthetic Length64 tests do not prove every native extended-length wire layout.

anchors: numeric-wire-forms
physical-length-pair
test-raw-decimal-retained-mdb
findings.finding: Current OMF Duration keeps the raw recorded fraction as the arithmetic rate; it does not apply the previously approved Avid ExactEditRate-to-rational interpreter. A separate compression-name alias does not change Duration. Bella should use the already agreed source/type-qualified interpretation boundary, preserve raw pair, and not apply video aliases to audio sampling frequency or arbitrary rational fields.

anchors: own-edit-clock
physical-length-pair
findings.finding: For audio, the descriptor sample clock divides the sample count. Own file CPNT:EditRate provides a separate frame-numbering/display clock; OMF2 MSLT fallback is implemented but that schema is deferred for Bella. For video current displayRate equals its raw unitsRate. A bad or missing audio display clock does not erase retained count/sample clock.

findings.finding: Current audio fallback uses a valid unambiguous frequency decoded from the same owned WAVD:Summary.fmt or AIFD:Summary.COMM only when MDFL rate is unusable. Contextual WAVE descriptor compatibility also accepts WAVD:Summary.fmt. Descriptor Length remains the count; Summary count is not used because duration=false. This is existing bounded compatibility behavior, not evidence every malformed MDFL field should be hidden. Reviewed authored summary tests default MDB; no real missing-rate OMF specimen was established here.

findings.finding: The separate native WAV/AIFF route may independently produce a sample count and sampling clock from format/chunk metadata. Current shared selection can combine a display clock only from same-count/equivalent-rate Duration observations. It does not add counts. Native outer duration and copied OMF descriptor duration are distinct facts; a source-coherent Bella decision should not silently substitute an outer sample count for OMF Length.

findings.finding: Current timecode scan traverses file components and recursively referenced source mobs, collecting any TCCP Flags/Drop integer0/1. It does not record invalid flags as damaged numbering observations or qualify them against a specific display clock/FPS/track relation. Missing, damaged or conflicting selected DropFrame eventually becomes false via toBool(), yielding NDF; formatter enables DF solely for nominal base30/60. Bella’s earlier qualified flag, missing-vs-damaged and coherent-source rules should replace those gaps; no damaged actual specimen was executed.

findings.finding: Useful current shared behavior: exact count/rate retention, integer frame conversion, positive-half-up final rounding, nominal frame numbering, DF semicolons and durations beyond24hours. Current known() requires positive count and durationTimecode rejects displayFrames<=0, so establishedzero and positive values roundingzero displayblank. Base may fall back to a rounded FrameRate label. These known gaps were already covered by Bella’s accepted zero/availability and qualified-clock design.

findings.finding: All test cases were inspected only. Named OMF-projection drop/physical-duration and summary-rate tests use the default MDB reader. Direct native OmfReader cases verify native audio counts; genuine OMF rows assert duration evidence but not exact label/DF. Shared math/selector/formatter assertions are not direct OMF parser proof. No measured runtime or metadata-correctness improvement is claimed.

minimalBellaProposalAwaitingApproval: Preserve the established physical-file meaning: qualified own descriptor Length and rate first, not a referencing clip or master span. Keep raw Length and raw SampleRate fraction with typed source context, interpreted clock and compact availability as needed.

Use already agreed Avid ExactEditRate interpretation only in its verified Avid video/display-clock context before elapsed-duration/display-frame arithmetic. Preserve raw values. Audio sampling frequency remains an audio sample clock, not a nominal video rate.

Retain current bounded same-owned-summary frequency fallback for supported WAVD/AIFD and existing contextual WAVE compatibility when MDFL rate is unusable, provided the required owner/summary representation and valid unambiguous sampling frequency are established. Keep OMF Length as count; no summary frame-count, outer native sample-count, master or source-count substitution. Do not parse a Summary solely when the valid descriptor pair already suffices; decoder/layout details remain upcoming Sample Rate/native-audio review.

For audio, use qualified own-file editing rate only as a display clock; preserve exact samples. Use one shared exact integer/fraction display interpreter with the already agreed rounding, known-zero/rounded-zero, blank unavailable/overflow, DF separators and no24-hour-wrap behavior.

Apply already agreed correct linked drop-frame semantics: a compatible qualified recorded flag controls numbering; genuinely absent means NDF; damaged or unresolved required numbering leaves formatted Duration unavailable while preserving exact independent data. OMF-specific track/FPS selection details require native/actual evidence, not blind copying of broad recursive current scan.

Keep compact timing values/status; release temporary raw/graph data. Source priority and extra header opening remain separate. Preserve existing correct outputs and useful tests, making only verified planned corrections; no unmeasured speed/accuracy claim.

Current generic scalar conversion accepts more decoded types than a field-specific wire whitelist; Bella should retain known type/width meaning.
Formatter0 currently conflates unavailable/overflow and valid roundedzero; new zero display needs an explicit success/availability distinction.

"""Bounded metadata-only timing probe of five previously qualified OMF files.

Research for the known Bento1/II examples; not Bella/runtime parser code,
arbitrary-input validation, format limits or a performance benchmark.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import struct
from pathlib import Path

DEST = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-duration-observed-20261024')
DEST.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
PRIOR = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-project-observed-20261024/findings.json')
prior = json.loads(PRIOR.read_text())
NAMES = {
    'OMFI:Version', 'OMFI:ByteOrder', 'OMFI:ObjectSpine',
    'OMFI:SourceMobs', 'OMFI:CompositionMobs', 'OMFI:MediaData',
    'OMFI:ObjID', 'OMFI:MOBJ:MobID', 'OMFI:MOBJ:PhysicalMedia',
    'OMFI:MOBJ:UsageCode', 'OMFI:TRKG:Tracks', 'OMFI:TRKG:GroupLength',
    'OMFI:TRAK:TrackComponent', 'OMFI:TRAK:LabelNumber',
    'OMFI:SCLP:SourceID', 'OMFI:SCLP:SourceTrack',
    'OMFI:SCLP:SourcePosition', 'OMFI:SEQU:Sequence',
    'OMFI:WAVE:MobID', 'OMFI:AIFC:MobID', 'OMFI:TIFF:MobID',
    'OMFI:MDAT:MobID', 'OMFI:MDFL:Length', 'OMFI:MDFL:SampleRate',
    'OMFI:CPNT:EditRate', 'OMFI:CPNT:TrackKind', 'OMFI:CLIP:Length',
    'OMFI:TCCP:Flags', 'OMFI:TCCP:FPS', 'OMFI:TCCP:Start',
    'OMFI:TCCP:Drop', 'OMFI:MDFL:MC:Length64',
    'OMFI:PCMA:AudioSamplingRate',
}

rows = []
for previous in prior['files']:
    path = Path(previous['path'])
    before = path.stat()
    reads = []
    captures = []
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        def read_at(offset, count):
            assert 0 <= offset <= before.st_size
            assert 0 <= count <= before.st_size - offset
            stream.seek(offset)
            raw = stream.read(count)
            assert len(raw) == count
            reads.append({'offset': offset, 'bytes': count,
                          'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
            return raw

        label_offset = before.st_size - 24
        assert label_offset == previous['labelOffset']
        label = read_at(label_offset, 24)
        assert label[:8] == bytes.fromhex('a4434da5486472d7')
        assert struct.unpack('<HH', label[12:16]) == (1, 0)
        toc_offset, toc_count = struct.unpack('<II', label[16:24])
        assert toc_offset == previous['tocOffset']
        assert toc_count == previous['tocBytes']
        assert 0 < toc_count < 2 * 1024 * 1024 and toc_count % 24 == 0
        assert toc_offset + toc_count <= label_offset
        toc = read_at(toc_offset, toc_count)
        old_toc = next(c for c in previous['captures']
                       if c['offset'] == toc_offset)
        assert hashlib.sha256(toc).hexdigest() == old_toc['sha256']
        entries = []
        for pos in range(0, len(toc), 24):
            obj, prop, typ, location, count, generation, flags = struct.unpack(
                '<IIIIIHH', toc[pos:pos+24])
            assert not flags & ~3
            offset = toc_offset + pos + 12 if flags & 1 else location
            structural = obj == 1 and typ == 19 and prop in (4, 5, 7)
            limit = before.st_size if structural or flags & 1 else toc_offset
            assert 0 <= offset <= limit and count <= limit - offset
            assert not flags & 1 or count <= 4
            entries.append({'object': obj, 'property': prop, 'type': typ,
                            'offset': offset, 'length': count,
                            'generation': generation, 'flags': flags})

        def value(entry):
            assert entry['length'] <= 512  # Known-example probe guard only.
            assert not entry['flags'] & 2  # No selected continuation supported.
            if entry['flags'] & 1:
                pos = entry['offset'] - toc_offset
                return toc[pos:pos+entry['length']]
            return read_at(entry['offset'], entry['length'])

        names = {}
        for entry in entries:
            if entry['property'] in (23, 24):
                names[entry['object']] = value(entry).split(b'\0')[0].decode('ascii')
        selected = []
        for entry in entries:
            name = names.get(entry['property'])
            if name not in NAMES:
                continue
            raw = value(entry)
            row = {**entry, 'propertyName': name,
                   'typeName': names.get(entry['type'], ''), 'hex': raw.hex()}
            if name in {'OMFI:MDFL:SampleRate', 'OMFI:CPNT:EditRate',
                        'OMFI:PCMA:AudioSamplingRate'} and len(raw) == 8:
                row['rawSignedRateWords'] = list(struct.unpack('<ii', raw))
            if name in {'OMFI:MDFL:Length', 'OMFI:CLIP:Length',
                        'OMFI:TRKG:GroupLength', 'OMFI:SCLP:SourcePosition',
                        'OMFI:TCCP:Start'} and len(raw) in (4, 8):
                row['rawSignedCount'] = int.from_bytes(raw, 'little', signed=True)
            if name in {'OMFI:TCCP:Flags', 'OMFI:TCCP:FPS',
                        'OMFI:CPNT:TrackKind', 'OMFI:TRAK:LabelNumber',
                        'OMFI:SCLP:SourceTrack'} and len(raw) in (2, 4):
                row['rawUnsignedInteger'] = int.from_bytes(raw, 'little')
            selected.append(row)
        assert [r['hex'] for r in selected
                if r['propertyName'] == 'OMFI:ByteOrder'] == ['4949']
        for old in previous['selectedSmallRawProperties']:
            if old['propertyName'] in NAMES:
                matching = [r for r in selected if r['object'] == old['object']
                            and r['property'] == old['property']]
                assert matching and any(r['hex'] == old['hex'] for r in matching)

    after = path.stat()
    assert (before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ino) == (
        after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ino)
    physical = []
    for media in previous['physicalMediaObservations']:
        owner = next(m for m in previous['activeMobObservations']
                     if m['object'] == media['matchedDescriptorOwnerObject'])
        own_values = [r for r in selected if r['object'] in
                      (owner['object'], owner['descriptor'])]
        physical.append({'physicalMedia': media, 'fileOwner': owner,
                         'selectedOwnTimingAndIdentity': own_values})
    rows.append({'path': str(path), 'fileBytes': before.st_size,
                 'mtimeNs': before.st_mtime_ns, 'inode': before.st_ino,
                 'stableImmediate': True, 'container': 'Bento1.0/legacyOMF1',
                 'numericByteOrder': 'II', 'labelOffset': label_offset,
                 'tocOffset': toc_offset, 'tocBytes': toc_count,
                 'tocSha256': hashlib.sha256(toc).hexdigest(),
                 'agreesWithPriorTocAndSelectedContext': True,
                 'selectedSmallRawProperties': selected,
                 'physicalOwnerTiming': physical, 'reads': reads,
                 'logicalBytesReturned': sum(r['bytes'] for r in reads)})

output = {'date': '2026-10-24', 'timezone': 'Australia/Sydney',
          'scope': 'Five known installed/live file paths, fresh bounded timing metadata reads only. No recording payload or native audio chunk read, parser/app/test execution or benchmark.',
          'script': {'path': __file__, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
          'priorOwnerContext': {'path': str(PRIOR), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(PRIOR.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
          'files': rows,
          'limits': ['Known Bento1/II examples only; guards/continuation assumptions are probe limits, not Bella support rules.',
                     'Owner graphs reuse prior qualified observations, with fresh identical TOC/context checks. No comprehensive arbitrary graph/timecode applicability interpreter.',
                     'Modern specification fields/types do not broaden the accepted legacy release-one wire scope.',
                     'No native chunk or audio summary read for this Duration probe.']}
(DEST/'findings.json').write_text(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
for f in rows:
    own = f['physicalOwnerTiming'][0]
    print(Path(f['path']).name)
    for r in own['selectedOwnTimingAndIdentity']:
        if 'rawSignedRateWords' in r or 'rawSignedCount' in r:
            print(' ', r['object'], r['propertyName'], r['typeName'],
                  r.get('rawSignedRateWords', r.get('rawSignedCount')))
    print(' timecode values', len([r for r in f['selectedSmallRawProperties']
                                  if r['propertyName'].startswith('OMFI:TCCP:')]))
print('logical bytes', sum(f['logicalBytesReturned'] for f in rows))

"""Arithmetic/relationship illustration from recorded timing bytes, no media I/O.

Not a run of OldScanner, Bella or the Media Composer Duration UI.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction
import json
import hashlib

SOURCE = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-duration-observed-20261024/findings.json')
recorded = json.loads(SOURCE.read_text())
prior = json.loads(Path(recorded['priorOwnerContext']['path']).read_text())

def interpret_clock(words):
    rate = Fraction(*words)
    for k in range(1, 11):
        for decimal, exact in [(Fraction(23976, 1000), Fraction(24000, 1001)),
                               (Fraction(2997, 100), Fraction(30000, 1001))]:
            if rate == decimal * k:
                return exact * k
    return rate

def pair(rate):
    return [rate.numerator, rate.denominator]

results = []
for f in recorded['files']:
    properties = f['selectedSmallRawProperties']
    def one(obj, name):
        rows = [r for r in properties if r['object'] == obj and r['propertyName'] == name]
        assert len(rows) == 1, (obj, name, len(rows))
        return rows[0]
    def raw(obj, name):
        return bytes.fromhex(one(obj, name)['hex'])
    def uint(obj, name):
        return int.from_bytes(raw(obj, name), 'little')
    def count(obj, name):
        assert one(obj, name)['typeName'] == 'omfi:Long'
        assert one(obj, name)['length'] == 4
        return int.from_bytes(raw(obj, name), 'little', signed=True)
    def refs(obj, name):
        value = raw(obj, name)
        assert len(value) == 2 + 8 * int.from_bytes(value[:2], 'little')
        return [int.from_bytes(value[p:p+4], 'little') for p in range(2, len(value), 8)]
    def ref(obj, name):
        value = raw(obj, name)
        assert len(value) == 8
        return int.from_bytes(value[:4], 'little')
    def cls(obj):
        return raw(obj, 'OMFI:ObjID').decode('ascii')
    def rate_words(obj, name):
        prop = one(obj, name)
        assert prop['typeName'] == 'omfi:ExactEditRate' and prop['length'] == 8
        return prop['rawSignedRateWords']

    context = f['physicalOwnerTiming'][0]
    owner = context['fileOwner']['object']
    descriptor = context['fileOwner']['descriptor']
    tag = cls(descriptor)
    length = count(descriptor, 'OMFI:MDFL:Length')
    stored_rate = rate_words(descriptor, 'OMFI:MDFL:SampleRate')
    own_edit_words = rate_words(owner, 'OMFI:CPNT:EditRate')
    audio = tag in ['WAVD', 'AIFD']
    units_rate = Fraction(*stored_rate) if audio else interpret_clock(stored_rate)
    display_rate = interpret_clock(own_edit_words) if audio else units_rate
    seconds = Fraction(length, 1) / units_rate
    display_frames = seconds * display_rate
    quotient, remainder = divmod(display_frames.numerator, display_frames.denominator)
    rounded_frames = quotient + (2 * remainder >= display_frames.denominator)
    base = (display_rate.numerator * 2 + display_rate.denominator) // (2 * display_rate.denominator)
    # All observed selected modes here are NDF; no new DF arithmetic is claimed.
    flags_seen = [p for p in properties if p['propertyName'] == 'OMFI:TCCP:Flags']
    assert len(flags_seen) == 1 and flags_seen[0]['hex'] == '00000000'
    qualification = {'displayClock': pair(display_rate),
                     'mode': 'NDF', 'timecodeFlagsObserved': flags_seen[0]}
    if display_rate == Fraction(30000, 1001):
        tracks = refs(owner, 'OMFI:TRKG:Tracks')
        clips = [ref(t, 'OMFI:TRAK:TrackComponent') for t in tracks]
        assert len(clips) == 1 and cls(clips[0]) == 'SCLP'
        clip = clips[0]
        assert uint(clip, 'OMFI:CPNT:TrackKind') == 1
        assert count(clip, 'OMFI:SCLP:SourcePosition') == 0
        assert interpret_clock(rate_words(clip, 'OMFI:CPNT:EditRate')) == display_rate
        assert count(clip, 'OMFI:CLIP:Length') >= length
        source_id = raw(clip, 'OMFI:SCLP:SourceID').hex()
        old = next(v for v in prior['files'] if v['path'] == f['path'])

        source = sources[0]['object']
        assert raw(source, 'OMFI:MOBJ:MobID').hex() == source_id
        source_track_number = uint(clip, 'OMFI:SCLP:SourceTrack')
        picture = []
        timecodes = []
        for t in refs(source, 'OMFI:TRKG:Tracks'):
            component = ref(t, 'OMFI:TRAK:TrackComponent')
            kind = uint(component, 'OMFI:CPNT:TrackKind')
            if kind == 1 and uint(t, 'OMFI:TRAK:LabelNumber') == source_track_number:
                picture.append(component)
            if kind == 3 and cls(component) == 'TCCP':
                timecodes.append(component)
        assert len(picture) == 1 and len(timecodes) == 1
        tc = timecodes[0]
        assert count(picture[0], 'OMFI:CLIP:Length') >= length
        assert interpret_clock(rate_words(tc, 'OMFI:CPNT:EditRate')) == display_rate
        assert uint(tc, 'OMFI:TCCP:FPS') == 30
        assert count(tc, 'OMFI:TCCP:Flags') == 0
        assert count(tc, 'OMFI:CLIP:Length') >= length
        qualification.update({'method': 'Known simple immediate-source path: full source ID, matching picture track label/kind, zero source position, common interpreted clocks, one timecode component with compatible FPS and covering span.',
                              'fileSourceClip': clip, 'sourceMob': source,
                              'sourceMobFullStoredIdHex': source_id,
                              'sourcePictureComponent': picture[0],
                              'sourceTimecodeComponent': tc,
                              'spanUnits': count(tc, 'OMFI:CLIP:Length'),
                              'nominalFPS': 30})
    else:
        assert display_rate == 25
        qualification['method'] = 'Supported NDF-only 25 fps clock needs no DF lookup. Source flag observation does not claim complete applicability for the audio samples beyond their editorial span.'
    whole_seconds, frame = divmod(rounded_frames, base)
    whole_minutes, second = divmod(whole_seconds, 60)
    hour, minute = divmod(whole_minutes, 60)
    label = f'{hour:02}:{minute:02}:{second:02}:{frame:02}'
    assert label == ('00:01:00:00' if audio else '00:00:00:01')
    results.append({'path': f['path'], 'descriptorTag': tag, 'Length': length,
